value.rationale: The 2026 sharp Fejer pointwise inequality previously had a zero-deficit classification but no quantified proximity of arbitrary Fejer–Riesz coefficients to the equality line. This theorem supplies the exact optimal stability gap for every degree and the complete eigenmode structure, including a nontrivial parity switch in the least stable direction. It is a natural coercivity invariant for perturbative extremizer analysis, not an arbitrary finite sample or a renaming of the original inequality. The result remains strictly scoped to coefficient Hilbert distance.
